# Codex Pass shared UI

Source: https://github.com/flownet-tech/codex-pass-ui

Design and update guide: https://github.com/flownet-tech/codex-pass-ui/blob/main/DESIGN.md

Generated from packages/tokens, version 0.2.0. The archive filename contains its SHA-256 prefix. Do not edit the archive: change the shared source, build, distribute to the selected checkouts and refresh each lockfile. Commit the archive and lockfile together; consumers build independently without registry credentials.
